origin.thread_label: Temporal integrity / lookahead leakage kill test v1 (E1X)

title: Join copper/gold settled bars in the event study by knowledge time, not bar-end time
objective: Make scripts/research/copper_gold_slow_cycle_event_study.py implement its own documented rule ('Copper/Gold is joined only from settled bars known by the event date'). A settled 2M bar may be joined, and a signal event may be entered, only at or after the bar's knowledge time. Knowledge time = the owner-recorded publication date (workbook_updated_on in 03_DAILY_CAPTURE_LOGS/slow_cycle/copper_gold/revisions) where one exists; for months without a recorded publication the run must receive an explicit publication-lag lower bound argument (no default; fail closed when absent) and must write it into the output. Signal events enter at the first BTC end-of-day at or after knowledge time. Emit a NEW study version; never rewrite HISTORICAL_EVENT_STUDY_v2.json.

evidence.summary: Merged E1X evidence owner, merge commit 6c971fe01078332c88d4f13eef160235c61c72c3.

16/16 signal events fail right truncation at their claimed decision time with the owner-recorded publication lag as knowledge time; 24/24 peak state joins pass; the same code passes when bar end is assumed to be knowledge time (RT-A06a).
workbook_updated_on: July 2026 data published 2026-08-04, August 2026 data 2026-09-02
kill criterion K02: lookahead or incomplete-bar use required to retain apparent edge
exact BTC input of the published study; v2 anchor_results reproduced byte-identically before the sensitivity run

reproduction: python scripts/experiments/strategy_factor_leakage_e1_production.py --coinmetrics-btc <btc.csv at the pinned revision> --event-features <settled_2m_features.csv at a008fd47d> --output /tmp/e1x.json; inspect right_truncation case RT-A06b (FAIL, TRUE_FUTURE_LEAKAGE, minimal suffix = the joined bar's own record). Unchanged production signal_events(..., shift_days=L) reproduces the impact: FEB_MAR TURNING_POSITIVE 60d median +23.61% at L=0 becomes +8.88% at L=2 and -9.65% at L=4.

positive: E1X RT-A06b passes when the event study's own knowledge-time rule is supplied as the record availability.
Peak-episode state joins are unchanged for bars whose knowledge time precedes the peak date.
The output records the knowledge-time rule, the explicit lag argument and every bar's knowledge timestamp.
negative: Running without an explicit publication-lag argument for months lacking a recorded publication fails closed.
No signal event's entry date precedes its bar's knowledge time.
No threshold, anchor definition, regime classifier or BTC peak rule changes.
No interpolation or invented publication date is written for any month.

clean_noop_condition: Stop if the study has been retired or already joins by knowledge time on fresh main.
escalation_condition: Stop and escalate if the fix requires choosing a publication-lag value in code or changing the live owner's schema.
